overview: The Medford City Council heard testimony from the Brooks Park Tenant Association regarding displacement and eviction notices, referred the first package of comprehensive zoning ordinance updates to the Community Development Board, and approved an appropriation for a public tree inventory. A contested motion regarding school budget funding and free cash reserves was tabled under council rules following heated debate.

items.title: Commendation for Former Council President Richard F. Caraviello
items.summary: Presented a council citation honoring former Council President Richard F. Caraviello as the Medford Chamber of Commerce 2024 Citizen of the Year.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions and Minutes Approval
items.summary: Approved resolutions recognizing Jewish American Heritage Month, Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month, and Memorial Day, and approved the records of May 14, 2024.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved reports from preliminary budget sessions, resident services subcommittees, administration and finance, and planning and permitting.

items.title: Resolution for a Resident's Guide to City Council Processes
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee to create a multi-language public guide explaining council operations.

items.title: CPA Appropriation for City Parks Tree Inventory
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $5,000 from the CPA General Reserve to Trees Medford and the DPW Forestry Division to inventory trees in public parks.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Great American Beer Hall LLC
items.summary: Approved a conditional common victualler license for the Great American Beer Hall LLC pending final departmental sign-offs, certificate of occupancy, and 30- and 60-day reviews.

items.title: Brooks Park Tenant Association Update and Eviction Concerns
items.summary: Heard testimony from Brooks Park tenants facing steep rent increases and eviction notices under new corporate ownership, voting to send a letter urging the owners to negotiate, requesting mayoral intervention, and referring a tenant mediation retainer concept to committee.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Amendments Package 1
items.summary: Referred the first package of zoning updates—addressing table of use formatting, definitions, a digital GIS map, and municipal use exemptions—to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Resolution on Asian American Community Liaison Position
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update from the administration regarding plans and grant funding to establish an Asian American community liaison position.

items.title: School Committee Budget and Free Cash Utilization
items.summary: Debated a proposal to request the mayor allocate $5 to $7 million in free cash to level-fund the school department before the item was tabled under council financial rules.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Received public comment opposing Proposition 2 1/2 overrides, urging immediate stabilization of school funding from the teachers union, and addressing city property leasing.
